title: 第17章 水衍珠新增能力第18章 周鸿瑜
content_zh:
购得心仪的灵鱼后，李衍道并未急于离开，而是继续在地摊间悠闲地漫步。
他四处搜寻，最终挑选了二十条胧香鱼收入囊中。
随后，他转向了售卖各类灵种的区域。
以他目前的灵植师能力，每月最多能够照料三百株灵草类的灵植。
然而，若面对的是灵花、灵芝或是灵果树这样的灵植，在施展水泽滋生术时，则需耗费更多的灵力。
尽管如此，李衍道依然认为，丰富灵田中的灵植种类能有效地抵御各类虫害。
有的虫害偏好在灵草中滋生，有的则更倾向于在灵果树上筑巢，甚至有的会在灵花或灵芝之间徘徊。
尽管如此，李衍道并不打算盲目地种植所有种类的灵植。
以他目前所掌握的水泽滋生术以及自身的修为，他有能力照料的是一阶上品的灵植。
然而，一阶上品的灵植需要栽种在一阶上品的灵田之中，而以李家现有的条件，尚不具备开辟这样高级别灵田的能力。
因此，李衍道所能实际选择种植的，仍然是更为普通的、适合一阶下品灵田的灵植。
在各个角落穿梭时，李衍道的目光最终停在了一个售卖各种来历不明种子的小摊前。
摊主面容沧桑，摊位上的种子虽多，但却透露出一股淡淡的衰败气息，显然这些种子并不像其他摊位中的那样新鲜活力。
李衍道推测，这些种子恐怕并非摊主亲手培育，或许是从别处掠夺而来。
“这位道友，看上什么，可以随意选择，所有种子一律一灵石十粒。”摊主笑容可掬地招呼道。
李衍道微微点头，俯身仔细审视着那些看似平凡无奇的种子。
他根据最近所学的灵植师知识，精心挑选了三十粒自己能够辨认并确认其价值的种子。
接着，他又在那些陌生而未知的种子中，挑选了三种他认为具有潜力的品种，凑足四十粒。
“给，一共四块灵石。”李衍道将灵石递给了摊主。
摊主接过灵石，笑眯眯地说：“道友慢走！”

完成交易后，李衍道并未在此多作停留，而是继续向前走去，最终随意选择了一家店铺，将他携带的所有胖头鲤出售掉。
正如他所预料的那样，胖头鲤的价格已经大幅下跌，再也回不到过去每条一灵石五十碎灵的时期，如今只能卖出一灵石一条的价格。
这次爷爷捕获了二十七条胖头鲤，最终换得了二十七块灵石。
就在李衍道准备离开青元坊市门口之际，一对老少组合吸引了他的注意。
他们正在门口的地摊市场上展示一株灵桃树。
青元坊市拥有多个地摊市场，而门口的这个市场因为拥有最高的客流量，所以摆摊的费用也是最为昂贵的。
老者与女子的摊位前围满了好奇的顾客，女子正热情洋溢地向众人介绍：
“各位道友，这株水灵桃树乃是五年期灵植，它结出的水灵桃乃是一阶中品灵果。
不论是桃花、桃果，还是桃花露水，都是蕴含灵力的一阶资源。
不仅可以用来酿制美味的桃花酿，甚至还可以作为炼制丹药的重要材料。
现在，只需一百五十灵石，这株珍贵的灵植就可以带走了。”
女子的话音刚落，李衍道的眉头不由自主地微微皱起。
他知道，水灵桃实际上属于黄皮灵植，然而眼前这株灵桃树的顶部侧枝已经显现出淡淡的蓝色。
content_en:
After buying his favorite soul fish, Li Yandao was not in a hurry to leave, but continued to stroll leisurely among the stalls.
He searched everywhere and finally selected twenty sweet fish and took them into his bag.
Then, he turned to the area where various spiritual seeds were sold.
With his current ability as a spiritual planter, he can take care of up to three hundred spiritual plants of the spiritual grass type every month.
However, if you are facing spiritual plants such as spiritual flowers, Ganoderma lucidum or spiritual fruit trees, you will need to spend more spiritual energy when performing the water breeding technique.
Despite this, Li Yandao still believes that enriching the spiritual plant species in spiritual fields can effectively resist various pests.
Some pests prefer to breed in spiritual grass, while others prefer to build their nests in spiritual fruit trees, and some even linger among spiritual flowers or Ganoderma lucidum.
Despite this, Li Yandao does not intend to blindly plant all kinds of spiritual plants.
With the water breeding technique he currently masters and his own cultivation, he has the ability to take care of first-class high-grade spiritual plants.
However, first-grade high-grade spiritual plants need to be planted in first-grade high-grade spiritual fields, and with the current conditions of the Li family, they do not yet have the ability to open such high-level spiritual fields.
Therefore, what Li Yandao can actually choose to plant are still more common spiritual plants suitable for first-order low-grade spiritual fields.
While walking around various corners, Li Yandao's eyes finally stopped in front of a stall selling various seeds of unknown origin.
The stall owner had a vicissitudes of life. Although there were many seeds on the stall, they gave off a faint aura of decay. Obviously, these seeds were not as fresh and vibrant as those in other stalls.
Li Yandao speculated that these seeds may not have been cultivated by the stall owner himself, but may have been plundered from elsewhere.
"Fellow Taoist, you can choose whatever you like. All seeds are worth ten spiritual stones." The stall owner greeted with a smile.
Li Yandao nodded slightly and leaned over to carefully examine the seemingly ordinary seeds.
Based on the knowledge he recently learned as a spiritual planter, he carefully selected thirty seeds that he could identify and confirm their value.
Then, he selected three varieties that he thought had potential among the strange and unknown seeds, and collected forty seeds.
"Here, four spiritual stones in total." Li Yandao handed the spiritual stones to the stall owner.
The stall owner took the spirit stone and said with a smile: "Fellow Taoist, walk slowly!"
After completing the transaction, Li Yandao did not stay here longer, but continued to move forward, and finally randomly selected a shop to sell all the fat-headed carp he carried.
As he expected, the price of fat-headed carp has dropped significantly. It will never go back to the past when each carp had one spirit stone and fifty pieces of spirit. Now it can only be sold for one spirit stone.
This time, grandpa caught twenty-seven fat-headed carp, and finally exchanged them for twenty-seven spiritual stones.
Just as Li Yandao was about to leave the gate of Qingyuanfang City, a pair of old and young people attracted his attention.
They were displaying a peach tree at the street stall market at the door.
Qingyuanfang City has multiple street stall markets, and because the market at the door has the highest customer flow, the cost of setting up stalls is also the most expensive.
The stalls of the old man and the woman were crowded with curious customers, and the woman was introducing to everyone enthusiastically:
"Fellow Taoists, this water spirit peach tree is a five-year spiritual plant, and the water spirit peach it produces is a first-level mid-grade spiritual fruit.
Whether it is peach blossoms, peach fruits, or peach blossom dew, they are all first-level resources containing spiritual power.
Not only can it be used to brew delicious peach blossom stuffing, it can even be used as an important material for refining elixirs.
Now, with only one hundred and fifty spiritual stones, this precious spiritual plant can be taken away. "
As soon as the woman finished speaking, Li Yandao's brows wrinkled slightly involuntarily.
He knew that the Shui Ling Peach actually belonged to the yellow-skinned spiritual plant, but the top side branches of the peach tree in front of him already showed a faint blue color.
